statement: An SO(3)-equivariant scalar kernel on an SO(3)-invariant local domain cannot create l=2 output from pure l=0 input.
math_form: J=J_0(r) and [K,R]=0 for all R in SO(3) -> P_2 K[J_0]=0
implication: This is the first real kernel-cleaning result: kernel creation is killed by representation selection.
claim_scope: requires parent-signed kernel equivariance and l=0-only input

implication: This prevents a fake theorem: symmetry kills creation, not inherited anisotropy.
